save_format.note: CvTeamAI writes its expansion flag as 1 and two arrays of war success at the last war review; saves from older DLLs (flag 0) load, saves written by this DLL do not load in older DLLs.

bits.1: declare a prepared war once 40-70 % of the offensive land units stand within three plots of the target
bits.2: choose war targets by the land power each side has in the target's land areas; dogpiles only with own forces in reach
bits.4: review each chosen war once per period by its progress instead of a per-turn peace die
bits.8: bombard with any unit of the stack that can; collateral units open AI assaults
bits.16: collateral units join city attack stacks and are trained for invasions (off by default)
bits.32: pay and accept help in a war only from teams near the enemy
bits.64: archers and siege in a city fire ranged strikes at enemy units next to it
